snippet.title: Alice Nation 丨 Trailer
snippet.description:
Fall into a fairy-tale otherworld and embark on a tabletop adventure! This interactive narrative card game puts you in the role of Alice, a girl trapped in The Beyond. You will explore card-built scenes, solve puzzles, overcome enemies, and seek a way back to the real world.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3755350/Alice_Nation/
